description: This Java class 'PersistableImage' encapsulates image data for product images, including byte content, content type, and image name, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PersistableImage
classes.description: A Java class representing an image with byte data, content type, and image name, used for persisting product images.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets the byte array representing the image data.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the byte array of the image data.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME content type of the image.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME content type of the image.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the name of the image.

methods.name: getImageName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the image.
